name: DigitalOcean Console
author: Craig Derington
description: A secure, keyboard-friendly DigitalOcean infrastructure dashboard for the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Monitor and safely operate Droplets, Kubernetes, databases, App Platform, networking, storage, domains, projects, and billing through existing doctl contexts.

schema.label: Open-panel refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Polling frequency while the DigitalOcean panel is open.

schema.label: Background refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Polling frequency while the panel is closed. It is clamped to at least the open-panel interval.

schema.label: Desktop health notifications
schema.description: Notify when a previously healthy Droplet, cluster, database, or app becomes unhealthy, or when balance crosses the configured threshold.

schema.label: Low-balance warning threshold (USD)
schema.description: Mark the widget urgent and notify when a positive account balance drops below this value. Set to 0 to disable.
